input.content: Idempotency/recovery lookup keyed by the wrong identity: a save path stored recovery records under operation_id but looked them up by scanning for a matching workspace. Because completed records are retained for audit, any fresh operation ID for the same workspace matched the old completed record, skipped the apply, and returned success, so new values were silently dropped and the new operation had no audit record. Check: the lookup key must be the same as the dedupe key the contract defines (operation ID), and retained/completed records must not capture unrelated new requests.
